how: Opened the public Perplexity session page and selected the answer body (a table and citations) with a DOM range, then ran document.execCommand("copy").
notes: Perplexity session page, selection of the answer body: 2 tables, citations, source chips. The 'Copy' button under the answer wrote nothing to the clipboard in headless Chrome (no clipboard API call observed), so there is no copy-button capture.
